items.title: Quasi-coherent modules on the big etale and fppf sites of a scheme are the pullbacks of quasi-coherent modules on the scheme
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves seven statements identifying quasi-coherent modules on the big etale and fppf sites of a scheme S with the pullbacks of quasi-coherent modules on S, including the sheaf property for fppf coverings, the identifications with the pullbacks along pi_S and a_S, the resulting equivalences of categories, and the vanishing of the higher direct images of these pullbacks (statement lines 21926-21952). The proof (proof lines 21954-22025) identifies the presheaf with the pullback of a quasi-coherent module, derives the formal parts, and computes the higher direct images through affine etale coverings and the comparison of fppf with Zariski cohomology. H2: several independent statements with two genuine computations, written out in full.
